people.name: Hathach
people.line: A eunuch in the court of King Ahasuerus.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: So Hathach went out to Mordecai, to city square which was before the king’s gate.
translations.bsb: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the city square in front of the king’s gate,
translations.kjv: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.
translations.asv: So Hathach went forth to Mordecai unto the broad place of the city, which was before the king's gate.
